feedback.problem: The coefficient of ${z}^{4}$ in the expansion of ${(1-2z)}^{7}$ is
feedback.worked_solution:
The binomial expansion for $(1+x)^{n}$ is given by

$$
(1+x)^{n}=1+nx+\frac{n(n-1)}{2!}{x}^{2}+⋯.
$$

In particular, the ${x}^{4}$ term is given by

$$
\frac{n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)}{4!}{x}^{4}.
$$

Replacing $x$ with $-2z$ and $n$ with $7$ in the above expression, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7(7-1)(7-2)(7-3)}{4!}\cdot (-2z)^{4} & =\frac{7\cdot 6\cdot 5\cdot 4}{24}\cdot (-2)^{4}\cdot {z}^{4} \\  & =35\cdot 16{z}^{4} \\  & =560{z}^{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coefficient of ${z}^{4}$ is $560.$
